about_the_game:
This is a free multiplayer PC desktop game.

Gameplay concept

You can simply place the cube-man on the desktop. He has some different behavior modes, such as avoiding mouse and random shooting. He can accompany you or decorate your desktop while you are working.

Multiplayer

The most interesting part is to play with friends, you can let your friend join your desktop, then you can chat with each other or play challenge mode together. This is the first desktop game with multiplayer mode I've ever seen too.

Challenge mode

In challenge mode, you will fight against enemies with the goal of surviving longer and defeating more enemies. You can just idle casually, or try to challenge higher difficulties, or team up with friends for multiplayer challenges. Your performance in challenge mode will be recorded and included in the global rankings.

Level upgrade

The game is free to play with no in-app purchases, you can gain experience through idle time and unlocks more behavior modes. In addition，supporters can receive triple experiences in the game.

About developer

I am a amateur indie game developer. This game is designed and developed by myself only.
My QQ Mail: 910728069@qq.com
Welcome to try my another free game "Escape Expert"

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains cartoon violence, manifested as the characters being able to attack enemies with weapon，and they will shatter into many small cubes upon defeat.
